verdict.rationale: Mailgun documents a quickstart that claims a first send in under two minutes on a sandbox domain, and it offers multi-language SDKs and ready-to-use Postman requests. A community developer also calls it 'incredibly easy to integrate with'. However, the evidence never shows the quickstart is copy-paste complete per language, or that it surfaces required setup such as sandbox limits, API key retrieval, or the DKIM/custom-domain steps needed for production delivery. missing for 10: evidence of copy-paste-complete per-language quickstart snippets, explicit disclosure of required setup and sandbox restrictions, hands-on corroboration of the minutes-to-first-delivery claim

support.subject: As a developer, I can go from signup to my first delivered email in minutes — the quickstart is copy-paste complete for my language and doesn't hide required setup

citations.quote: Send an email in under two minutes using your sandbox domain
Our SDKs support multiple programming languages, allowing you to seamlessly send, receive, and track emails within your applications.
Our public workspace includes organized collections with examples, environment variables, and ready-to-use requests.
As a developer it's incredibly easy to integrate with
